title: Spec coverage sweep: traceability matrix + gap beads (all sections)
description: Epic: build docs/spec-coverage.md — a committed traceability matrix from every normative requirement in spec/*.md to implementation and tests. Classification buckets: implemented+tested / implemented+untested / divergent / not-implemented / ambiguous. Caps: ~10 gap beads per section, overflow noted in matrix. oscore/EDHOC semantics gaps: label human-only. Sections by requirement density: 09-packets-timing(167), 05-routing(123), 02a-coordinated-capacity(98), 03-adaptation(64), 06-security(56), 02-physical-link(51), 12-apps(30), 08-gateway-coordination(29), rest lower.
